author: jeremyphoward
text:
This is misleading.

This policy redefines the term "interactive" to mean "using an Anthropic front-end".

If you use `claude -p` or Agent SDK to do something interactively, it now uses credits, not your subscription limits. So the "interactive use" heading saying "unchanged"
